about: Every distinct string literal of ADK-Go's json_formatter_test.go (source json_formatter_test.go; test names, t.Error/Fatal/Log/Skip/Sprintf arguments, struct tags and imports excluded; constant + concatenations evaluated) plus probe extras (source extra), sorted, 0 invalid-UTF-8 literals left out (no Rust &str). Per input: isSensitiveKey -> bool; sanitizeURI, sanitizeRawText -> [string, changed]; redactErrorMessage, scrubErrorText, canonicalizeCredentialMarker -> string; redactJSONTextWithBudget(s, 0, fresh budget of maxSanitizeNodes) -> [string, changed, contentLost]; hasCredentialPattern, mayMatchTextPatterns -> bool; SmartTruncate100 = SmartTruncate(s, 100) as in smart_truncate_json.json. A string that is not valid UTF-8 is written as {"invalid_utf8_base64": ...}; a panic as {"panic": text}.
